items.title: 围绕“ChatGPT Classic”的困惑
items.text: 背景与摘要： OpenAI 向其全新的 macOS 桌面版“超级”应用过渡的过程充满了文档说明前后矛盾以及令人沮丧的安装体验。尽管官方支持文档暗示用户可以将新应用与旧版的“ChatGPT Classic”同时运行，但真实世界中的测试却暴露出了一个非确定性的过程：安装程序往往会完全覆盖旧版本，让用户很难保留或恢复原有的经典界面。

items.title: Summary
items.text: OpenAI’s transition to its new "super" desktop app for macOS has been marked by inconsistent documentation and a frustrating installation experience. While official support documents suggest that users can run the new app alongside the legacy "ChatGPT Classic," real-world testing reveals a non-deterministic process that often overwrites the old version entirely, leaving users unable to easily retain or recover the classic interface.

items.title: 官方立场
items.text:
根据 OpenAI 帮助中心的说法，这次过渡本应该是无缝的。系统会指示用户按照应用内的提示下载新版本。官方文档声称，这款集成了 Chat、Work 和 Codex 等功能的新应用可以与现有应用程序并排安装，允许两者共存：

  • ChatGPT: 功能丰富的新版桌面应用程序。
  • ChatGPT Classic: 上一个版本，该版本将继续接收模型更新、安全补丁和错误修复，尽管它可能缺乏最新的基于智能体的功能。
  • ChatGPT: The new, feature-rich desktop application.
  • ChatGPT Classic: The previous version, which continues to receive model updates, security patches, and bug fixes, though it may lack the latest agent-based features.

items.title: The Official Stance
items.text: According to OpenAI’s Help Center, the transition should be seamless. Users are instructed to follow an in-app prompt to download the new version. The documentation claims that the new app—which includes integrated Chat, Work, and Codex features—may install alongside the existing application, allowing both to coexist:

items.title: 升级的现实情况
items.text:
与官方文档相反，实际的用户体验充满了技术上的不一致：

  • 缺失提示: 在旧版应用中点击“检查更新 (Check for Updates)”命令，并不会触发下载全新“超级”应用的提示；它只是单纯地将经典版应用更新到了它的最新迭代。
  • 安装冲突: 通过磁盘映像手动下载新应用并不会如预期般运作。当旧版应用正在运行时，安装程序无法正确部署新版本。
  • 强制覆盖: 当旧版应用关闭时，安装程序往往会彻底替换掉经典版本，而不是将新应用与它并排安装。结果就是，“ChatGPT Classic”应用被移到了废纸篓，导致用户无法还原，也无法同时运行这两者。
  • Missing Prompts: The "Check for Updates" command in the legacy app does not trigger a prompt to download the new "super" app; it simply updates the classic app to its latest iteration.
  • Installation Conflicts: Manually downloading the new app via a disk image does not behave as expected. When the old app is running, the installer fails to properly deploy the new version.
  • Forced Overwrites: When the old app is closed, the installer often replaces the classic version entirely rather than installing the new app alongside it. Consequently, the "ChatGPT Classic" app is moved to the Trash, leaving the user with no way to revert or run both simultaneously.

items.title: The Reality of the Upgrade
items.text: Contrary to the official documentation, the actual user experience is fraught with technical inconsistencies:

items.title: 缺乏清晰度
items.text:
OpenAI 措辞上的模棱两可——使用诸如“可能会安装 (may install)”和“如果两者都保持安装状态 (if both remain installed)”之类的表述——表明，甚至连开发者自己也不确定安装时的具体行为。

对于一款拥有如此庞大用户基础的产品来说，这次重大更新的推出让人感觉脱节且不连贯。对于那些尚未安装“Classic”版本但希望保留经典体验的用户而言，目前没有一条清晰且可靠的途径，整个更新过程依然是一个令人沮丧的、充满不确定性的盲盒。

For a product with such a massive user base, the rollout of this major update feels disjointed. There is currently no clear, reliable path for users who wish to retain the "Classic" experience if they do not already have it installed, and the update process remains frustratingly non-deterministic.

来源：Daring Fireball

Source: Daring Fireball

items.title: A Lack of Clarity
items.text: The ambiguity in OpenAI’s language—using terms like "may install" and "if both remain installed"—suggests that even the developers are uncertain about the installation behavior.

items.title: 在 SQLite 中首选 STRICT 表
items.text:
背景与摘要： 本文主要探讨了 SQLite 中常被低估的 strict tables (严格表) 特性。该特性通过强制实施严格的类型约束，能够有效防止常见的类型错误，例如将文本插入整数列或在建表时使用了无效的数据类型。尽管开启该功能会带来诸如向后兼容性受限以及迁移现有数据较麻烦等微小妥协，但作者认为，严格表在大幅提升数据完整性和消除潜在 Bug 方面具有不可替代的作用。

Summary: SQLite's underrated strict tables feature enforces rigid typing to prevent common datatype errors—such as inserting text into integer columns or using invalid types upon table creation. While they come with minor trade-offs like backward-compatibility limits and migration friction, the author argues that strict tables significantly improve data integrity and eliminate subtle bugs.
path: 在 SQLite 中首选 STRICT 表

items.title: 简介
items.text:
SQLite 有一个经常被低估的功能：严格表 (strict tables)。严格表有助于强制执行严格的数据类型，从而防止犯下诸如将文本放入整数列之类的错误。

要创建一个严格表，只需在其定义末尾加上 STRICT 即可：

To make a strict table, simply add STRICT to the end of its definition:

-CREATE TABLE people (name TEXT);
+CREATE TABLE people (name TEXT) STRICT;
path: 在 SQLite 中首选 STRICT 表

items.title: Introduction
items.text: SQLite has a feature that is often underrated: strict tables. Strict tables help enforce rigid typing, preventing mistakes like putting text into integer columns.
path: 在 SQLite 中首选 STRICT 表

items.title: 严格表的优势
items.text: 广义上讲，严格表有助于强制实施严格的数据类型，使 SQLite 的行为与其他传统的 SQL 引擎保持一致。
path: 在 SQLite 中首选 STRICT 表

items.title: Advantages of Strict Tables
items.text: Broadly, strict tables help enforce rigid types, aligning SQLite with the behavior of other traditional SQL engines.
path: 在 SQLite 中首选 STRICT 表

items.title: 1. 防止 Insert/Update 时的类型不匹配
items.text:
默认情况下，SQLite 允许你将任何数据类型插入任何列中（例如，将文本放入 INTEGER 列）。严格表会拒绝这些不匹配的操作：

-- 非严格表允许你在任何地方放置任何内容（运行良好）
CREATE TABLE people_nonstrict (age INTEGER);
INSERT INTO people_nonstrict (age) VALUES ('garbage');

-- 严格表会抛出错误，防止数据损坏
CREATE TABLE people_strict (age INTEGER) STRICT;
INSERT INTO people_strict (age) VALUES ('garbage');
-- => 错误: 无法将 TEXT 值存储在 INTEGER 列中

同样的验证规则也适用于 UPDATE 语句。然而，对于可以无损转换的值（比如将字符串 '123' 插入到整数列中），依然会自动被接受。

This same validation applies to UPDATE statements. However, losslessly convertible values (like the string '123' being inserted into an integer column) are still accepted automatically.
path: 在 SQLite 中首选 STRICT 表

items.title: 1. Prevents Type Mismatches on Insert/Update
items.text: By default, SQLite allows you to insert any datatype into any column (e.g., putting text into an INTEGER column). Strict tables reject these mismatches:
path: 在 SQLite 中首选 STRICT 表

items.title: 2. 防止在建表时出现虚假的列类型
items.text:
默认情况下，SQLite 在建表期间会默默接受无效或拼写错误的数据类型而不会抛出错误：

-- 尽管这些是无效的类型，SQLite 依然会静默接受
CREATE TABLE tbl (name GARBAGE);
CREATE TABLE tbl (name DATETIME);
CREATE TABLE tbl (name JSON);

添加 STRICT 会强制这些操作立即报错，确保开发者只能使用受支持的类型：INT、INTEGER、REAL、TEXT、BLOB 以及 ANY。此外，严格表要求必须为每个字段明确指定列类型。

Appending STRICT forces these to error out immediately, ensuring developers only use supported types: INT, INTEGER, REAL, TEXT, BLOB, and ANY. Furthermore, strict tables require an explicit column type for every field.
path: 在 SQLite 中首选 STRICT 表

items.title: 2. Prevents Bogus Column Types on Table Creation
items.text: By default, SQLite accepts invalid or misspelled datatypes without throwing an error during table creation:
path: 在 SQLite 中首选 STRICT 表

items.title: 3. 仍可通过 ANY 保持灵活性
items.text:
如果你确实有意需要某一列接受多种类型的数据，即便是在严格表内部，你也可以使用 ANY 数据类型：

CREATE TABLE tbl (value ANY) STRICT;

-- 以下所有操作都保持有效：
INSERT INTO tbl (value) VALUES (123);
INSERT INTO tbl (value) VALUES ('text');
INSERT INTO tbl (value) VALUES (12.34);
INSERT INTO tbl (value) VALUES (X'8647');
path: 在 SQLite 中首选 STRICT 表

items.title: 3. Still Allows Flexibility with ANY
items.text: If you intentionally need a column to accept multiple types, you can use the ANY datatype, even inside a strict table:
path: 在 SQLite 中首选 STRICT 表

items.title: 严格表的劣势
items.text: 虽然严格表功能强大，但仍有几个缺点和边缘情况需要铭记在心：
path: 在 SQLite 中首选 STRICT 表

items.title: Disadvantages of Strict Tables
items.text: While strict tables are powerful, there are a few drawbacks and edge cases to keep in mind:
path: 在 SQLite 中首选 STRICT 表

items.title: 1. 无法轻松将现有表转换为 STRICT
items.text:
目前，你无法通过执行 ALTER 语句将现有的表转换为严格表。相反，你必须手动迁移数据：

-- 1. 使用期望的 schema 创建一个新的严格表
CREATE TABLE new_people (name TEXT) STRICT;

-- 2. 复制数据过来（如果现有数据违反了严格类型，则会失败）
INSERT INTO new_people SELECT * FROM people;

-- 3. 替换表名
DROP TABLE people;
ALTER TABLE new_people RENAME TO people;
path: 在 SQLite 中首选 STRICT 表

items.title: 1. Cannot Convert Existing Tables to STRICT easily
items.text: You cannot currently ALTER an existing table to make it strict. Instead, you must migrate the data manually:
path: 在 SQLite 中首选 STRICT 表

items.title: 2. SQLite 开发者的分歧
items.text: 官方 SQLite 文档中有一篇名为 “灵活类型的优势 (The Advantages Of Flexible Typing)” 的指南，该指南为动态类型在键值存储或导入杂乱的 CSV 文件等使用场景中进行了辩护。
path: 在 SQLite 中首选 STRICT 表

items.title: 2. The SQLite Developers Disagree
items.text: The official SQLite documentation features a guide titled “The Advantages Of Flexible Typing”, defending dynamic typing for use cases like key-value stores or importing messy CSV files.
path: 在 SQLite 中首选 STRICT 表

items.title: 3. 版本兼容性 (SQLite 3.37.0+)
items.text: 严格表功能是在 3.37.0 版本（2021 年 11 月）中引入的。较旧版本的 SQLite 无法读取包含严格表的数据库，这会导致错误。
path: 在 SQLite 中首选 STRICT 表

items.title: 3. Version Compatibility (SQLite 3.37.0+)
items.text: Strict tables were introduced in version 3.37.0 (November 2021). Older versions of SQLite cannot read databases containing strict tables, resulting in an error.
path: 在 SQLite 中首选 STRICT 表

items.title: 4. 性能影响微乎其微
items.text: 虽然严格表在写入时会执行额外的验证检查，但实际的基准测试表明，无论是在执行速度还是磁盘上的文件大小方面，都几乎看不到明显的差异。
path: 在 SQLite 中首选 STRICT 表

items.title: 4. Performance Impact is Negligible
items.text: While strict tables perform extra validation checks during writes, real-world benchmarks show virtually no noticeable difference in execution speed or file size on disk.
path: 在 SQLite 中首选 STRICT 表

items.title: 结论
items.text: 归根结底，严格表带来的好处远远超过了它的局限性。通过强制实施严格的类型约束，开发者从一开始就可以消除一整类隐蔽的 Bug，并显著提高数据的完整性。
path: 在 SQLite 中首选 STRICT 表

items.title: Conclusion
items.text: Ultimately, the benefits of strict tables far outweigh their limitations. By enforcing rigid types, developers can eliminate an entire category of subtle bugs and significantly improve data integrity from the start.
path: 在 SQLite 中首选 STRICT 表

items.title: 在 RTX 3090 上对 Qwen 3.6 35B MoE (3B 激活) 进行基准测试
path: 在 RTX 3090 上对 Qwen 3.6 35B MoE (3B 激活) 进行基准测试

items.title: 背景与摘要
items.text: 本文记录了作者在拥有 24GB 显存的 NVIDIA RTX 3090 显卡上运行 Qwen 3.6 35B 混合专家 (MoE) 模型的深入测试过程。面对 22GB 的显存占用（在 4-bit 量化下），作者利用 llama.cpp 工具测试了不同的后端 (CUDA vs Vulkan) 和 CPU 卸载 (-ncmoe) 参数。测试发现，使用源码编译的 CUDA 版本性能远超 Vulkan，并且通过将 10-12 层网络卸载到 CPU，可以在保持实用推理速度（如生成速度约 140 tokens/s）的同时，利用模型高达 262k 的全量上下文窗口。
path: 在 RTX 3090 上对 Qwen 3.6 35B MoE (3B 激活) 进行基准测试

items.title: Summary
items.text:
本文详细介绍了一次在 NVIDIA RTX 3090 (24GB VRAM) 上运行 Qwen 3.6 35B 混合专家模型 (MoE) 的深入探索。通过利用 llama.cpp 并实验 CPU 卸载 (-ncmoe)，我探索了上下文窗口大小和推理速度之间的权衡。主要发现包括： * CUDA 对比 Vulkan： 在支持 CUDA 的情况下编译 llama.cpp，其性能显著优于默认的 Vulkan 构建，提供了更高的吞吐量和更大的上下文窗口。 * “最佳平衡点”： 将 10–12 层卸载到 CPU 可以让模型利用其完整的 262k 上下文窗口，同时保持可用的速度。 * 性能： 在 CUDA 上，当全量由 GPU 处理时，我实现了约 140 token/秒的生成速度和约 3,300 token/秒的提示词处理速度；而当卸载层以达到完整上下文时，速度则降至约 85 token/秒。

This post details a deep dive into running the Qwen 3.6 35B Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model on an NVIDIA RTX 3090 (24GB VRAM). By leveraging llama.cpp and experimenting with CPU offloading (-ncmoe), I explored the trade-offs between context window size and inference speed. Key findings include: * CUDA vs. Vulkan: Compiling llama.cpp with CUDA support significantly outperformed the default Vulkan build, providing higher throughput and larger context windows. * The "Sweet Spot": Offloading 10–12 layers to the CPU allows the model to utilize its full 262k context window while maintaining usable speeds. * Performance: On CUDA, I achieved ~140 tokens/s for generation and ~3,300 tokens/s for prompt processing with full GPU offload, dropping to ~85 tokens/s when offloading layers to reach full context.
path: 在 RTX 3090 上对 Qwen 3.6 35B MoE (3B 激活) 进行基准测试

items.title: The Model: Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B
items.text:
Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B 是一个混合专家模型，总计拥有 350 亿个参数，但每个 token 只有 30 亿个激活参数。值得注意的是，这些激活参数中有超过 10 亿个与嵌入层和输出头绑定在一起，只留下 20 亿个用于实际推理。因为该模型要求将全套权重保留在内存中（对于 4-bit 量化而言约 22GB），这挑战了 RTX 3090 24GB 显存的极限，因此必须仔细管理上下文窗口。

The Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B is a Mixture of Experts model with 35B total parameters but only 3B active parameters per token. Notably, over 1B of those active parameters are tied up in the embedding layer and output head, leaving only 2B for actual reasoning. Because the model requires keeping the full weight set in memory (approx. 22GB for 4-bit quantization), it pushes the 24GB VRAM limit of the RTX 3090, necessitating careful management of the context window.
path: 在 RTX 3090 上对 Qwen 3.6 35B MoE (3B 激活) 进行基准测试

items.title: Getting Started: Llama.cpp
items.text:
我最初在使用 Arch Linux 默认的基于 Vulkan 的 llama.cpp 包时遇到了问题，具体表现为“设备不支持分割缓冲区 (device does not support split buffers)”错误。通过调整参数——具体地说是设置 -sm none（因为我使用的是单 GPU）并使用 -ngl all——我成功地使模型稳定运行。

I initially encountered issues with the Arch Linux default Vulkan-based llama.cpp package, specifically "device does not support split buffers" errors. By adjusting parameters—specifically setting -sm none (since I am using a single GPU) and using -ngl all—I was able to stabilize the model.
path: 在 RTX 3090 上对 Qwen 3.6 35B MoE (3B 激活) 进行基准测试

items.title: Benchmarking Methodology
items.text:
为了获取准确的数据，我使用 llama-server 自动化了基准测试过程。我测试了不同程度的 CPU 卸载 (-ncmoe)，以观察在性能出现不可接受的下降之前，有多少层可以转移到系统 RAM 中。我使用了一个基于“莱姆测试 (Lem Test)”——一项极具挑战性的创意写作任务——的提示词，以确保模型必须执行大量的计算。

To get accurate data, I automated the benchmarking process using llama-server. I tested varying levels of CPU offloading (-ncmoe) to see how many layers could be moved to system RAM before performance degraded unacceptably. I used a prompt based on the "Lem Test"—a challenging creative writing task—to ensure the model had to perform significant computation.
path: 在 RTX 3090 上对 Qwen 3.6 35B MoE (3B 激活) 进行基准测试

items.title: The Results
path: 在 RTX 3090 上对 Qwen 3.6 35B MoE (3B 激活) 进行基准测试

items.title: Context Window Scaling
items.text:
将层卸载到 CPU 是为了给上下文窗口回收显存 (VRAM) 的主要机制。

Offloading layers to the CPU is the primary mechanism to reclaim VRAM for the context window. * Vulkan: 需要卸载 12 层才能达到完整的 262,144 上下文长度。 * Vulkan: Required 12 layers offloaded to reach the full 262,144 context length. * CUDA: 仅需卸载 10 层即可达到相同容量。 * CUDA: Required only 10 layers offloaded to reach the same capacity.
path: 在 RTX 3090 上对 Qwen 3.6 35B MoE (3B 激活) 进行基准测试

items.title: Throughput Comparison
items.text:
在所有指标上，CUDA 始终优于 Vulkan：

CUDA consistently outperformed Vulkan across all metrics:

Metric Vulkan (All GPU) CUDA (All GPU) Prompt Processing ~2,787 tok/s ~3,360 tok/s Generation Speed ~122 tok/s ~140 tok/s

注：为了达到完整上下文而卸载 12 层时，CUDA 维持在约 85 tok/s，而 Vulkan 则降至约 66 tok/s。

Note: When offloading 12 layers to reach full context, CUDA maintained ~85 tok/s, while Vulkan dropped to ~66 tok/s.
path: 在 RTX 3090 上对 Qwen 3.6 35B MoE (3B 激活) 进行基准测试

items.title: Conclusion
items.text:
在 24GB 显卡上运行 35B 的 MoE 模型是一种平衡的艺术。虽然 RTX 3090 受到其显存的限制，但通过 llama.cpp 将 FFN 层卸载到 CPU 的能力，使得运行具有巨大上下文窗口的高参数模型变得完全可行。对于使用 NVIDIA 硬件的用户，强烈建议使用带有 CUDA 支持的源代码编译，而不是使用通用的 Vulkan 版本，以此来最大化速度和上下文容量。

Running a 35B MoE model on a 24GB card is a balancing act. While the RTX 3090 is constrained by its VRAM, the ability to offload FFN layers to the CPU via llama.cpp makes it entirely viable to run high-parameter models with massive context windows. For users on NVIDIA hardware, compiling from source with CUDA support is highly recommended over using generic Vulkan builds to maximize both speed and context capacity.
path: 在 RTX 3090 上对 Qwen 3.6 35B MoE (3B 激活) 进行基准测试

items.title: Appendix: The Lem Test
items.text:
由 Ethan Mollick 推广的“莱姆测试”，要求 LLM 写一首关于理发的六行诗，其中每个单词都必须以字母“S”开头，同时保持悲惨、高尚的基调。

The "Lem Test," popularized by Ethan Mollick, challenges an LLM to write a six-line poem about a haircut where every word begins with the letter "S," while maintaining a tragic, lofty tone.

虽然这个 35B 的 Qwen 模型很难同时保持完美的押韵和“S”的限制，但对于一个仅有 20 亿活跃“推理”参数的模型来说，它生成的叙述却出奇地连贯。对于模型推理能力以及在高 token 计数生成期间的硬件吞吐量来说，这是一个极佳的压力测试。

While the 35B Qwen model struggled to maintain perfect rhyme and the "S" constraint simultaneously, it produced surprisingly coherent narratives for a model with only 2B active "reasoning" parameters. It serves as an excellent stress test for both the model's reasoning capabilities and the hardware's throughput during high-token-count generation.
path: 在 RTX 3090 上对 Qwen 3.6 35B MoE (3B 激活) 进行基准测试

items.title: 文章背景与核心概要
items.text: 本文由科里·多克托罗（Cory Doctorow）撰写，深入解构了当前流行的“后政治”温和主义，指出将左翼与右翼的分歧归结为“部落主义”是对生死攸关现实的漠视。核心结论在于：政治的根本分歧不在于文化符号，而在于“财产权究竟是人权，还是实现人权的工具”。真正的温和主义不过是右翼的伪装，其本质是将财产权凌驾于人类尊严与自由之上。

items.title: 后政治 (Post-political) (Permalink)
items.text:
[我们有充分的理由去怀疑那些哀叹“政治极化”并呼吁抛弃“左右翼部落主义”的温和派。]

There's plenty of reasons to be skeptical of centrists who bemoan "political polarization" and call for a politics that abandons the "tribalism of left and right."

[显而易见，这是一种虚假的对等：在右翼，你会看到法西斯分子希望派遣蒙面、武装的暴徒走上街头，去殴打、绑架和谋杀你的邻居；而在左翼，人们则在呼吁增加税收、成立工会、对数据中心进行环境影响评估，以及结束加沙地带的种族灭绝。]

Obviously there's the false equivalence: on the right, you have fascists who want to send masked, armed goons into the streets to beat, kidnap and murder your neighbors. On the left, you have calls for higher taxes, unions, environmental impact reviews for data-centers, and an end to the genocide in Gaza.

[所谓的“左翼极端主义”不过是搬弄几本小册子：]

"Leftist extremism" is moving some zines around:

The Guardian: Prairieland, Texas ICE Protests Zines

[而右翼极端主义则试图推翻政府、在古拉格中谋杀棕色人种，并且世界上最富有的人为了取乐而屠杀全世界最贫穷的儿童：]

Right wing extremism is attempting the overthrow of the government, murdering brown people in gulags, and the earth's richest man slaughtering the world's poorest children for the lulz:

Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health

[“马蹄铁理论”（即极右翼和极左翼最终会弯曲并在另一端相遇的观点）简直是一派胡言：]

"Horseshoe theory" (the idea that the far right and the far left actually bend around to meet each other) is bullshit:

Pluralistic: Horseshoe Crab

[现实情况是，左右翼之间存在着巨大而实质性的分歧，这些分歧关乎生死。任何将这些分歧贬低为“部落主义”的人，根本不知道“左翼”和“右翼”意味着什么。充其量，他们是将一堆文化符号——代词、综合格斗、啤酒品牌——误当作了政治。]

The reality is that the right and left have large, substantive disagreements that are matters of life and death. Anyone dismissing these as "tribalism" doesn't know what "left" and "right" mean. At best, they have mistaken a collection of cultural signifiers – pronouns, MMA, brands of beer – for politics.

[将文化符号和身份标记误认为政治，是温和主义最危险的病理，正是这一点让温和主义成为了右翼的帮凶。如果你认为身份标记就是政治，那么你就会倾向于认为：面对一个由150名富有、白人、顺性别异性恋男性统治的世界，解决问题的办法就是把其中一半人换成女性、有色人种和酷儿。左翼与右翼的区别不在于统治阶级的身份——而在于我们是否还要一个统治阶级。]

Mistaking cultural signifiers and identity markers for politics is centrism's most dangerous pathology, the thing that makes centrism the handmaiden of the right. If you think identity markers are politics, then you'll be tempted to think the answer to a world run by 150 rich, white, cis straight guys is to replace half of them with women, POCs and queer people. The difference between the left and the right isn't the identities of the ruling class – it's whether we have a ruling class at all.

[我收集了关于“右翼”和“左翼”的各种定义。柯里·罗宾（Corey Robin）在其著作《反动思维》（The Reactionary Mind）中曾这样定义保守主义：保守主义坚信某些人天生就该统治，而另企图将后一群人提升到权力地位（通过民权运动、平权行动等）的任何尝试，都将导致可怕的误政和灾难：]

I collect definitions of "right" and "left." There's Corey Robin's definition from The Reactionary Mind, that conservatism is the belief that some people were born to rule, and others to be ruled over, and that any attempt to elevate the latter group to positions of power (through civil rights movements, affirmative action, etc) will result in dire misrule and disaster:

Pluralistic: All Day Suckers

[这就解释了为什么右翼能够将白人民族主义者（由白人统治）、印度教民族主义者（由高种姓印度教徒统治）、自由意志主义者（由老板统治）、帝国主义者（由军事侵略者统治）等各种势力包容在一起。这也解释了右翼为何痴迷于探究飞机失事或其他灾难中涉事人员的种族和性别标签：“你看，那艘油轮撞上桥梁时，开船的是个DEI招聘的人！”]

This explains how the right can encompass white nationalists (rule by white people), Hindu nationalists (rule by high-caste Hindus), libertarians (rule by bosses), imperialists (rule by military aggressors), etc. It also explains the right's obsession with learning the racial and gender markers of anyone involved in a plane crash or other disaster: "See, the oil tanker was being piloted by a DEI hire when it crashed into that bridge!"

[另一个重要的定义是威霍伊特法则（Wilhoit's Law）：]

Another important definition is Wilhoit's Law:

保守主义恰好由一个命题组成，即：法律必须存在两类群体——其中一类群体受到法律保护却不受其约束，而另一类群体则受到法律约束却不受其保护。 Conservatism consists of exactly one proposition, to wit: There must be in-groups whom the law protects but does not bind, alongside out-groups whom the law binds but does not protect.

Pluralistic: Sole and Despotic Dominion

[在这个“如果总统做这事就不算犯罪”的时代，这个法则几乎不需要过多的解释——就像亚历克斯·琼斯（Alex Jones）可以欠下数十名被谋杀儿童父母数十亿美元的债务，却不知何故不必偿还也无需交出资产一样：]

This one hardly needs explanation in this era of "it's not a crime if the president does it," where Alex Jones can owe billions to the parents of dozens of murdered children and somehow not have to pay or give up his assets:

Status News: Infowars, The Onion, Alex Jones

[但当谈到那种“既非右翼也非左翼的后政治”时，我最常引用的定义来自于科幻作家史蒂芬·布鲁斯特（Steven Brust），他曾对我说过：]

But when it comes to a "post-politics that is neither right nor left," the definition I turn to most often comes from science fiction writer Steven Brust, who once told me:

“自法国大革命以来，‘左翼’和‘右翼’的含义就一直没有变。如果你想知道某人是左翼还是右翼，去问他：‘什么更重要：人权还是财产权？’如果他们回答‘财产权就是人权’，那他们就是右翼。” "Left" and "right" have had the same meaning since the French Revolution. If you want to know if someone is on the left or the right, ask them, "What is more important: human rights or property rights?" If they say "Property rights are a human right," then they are on the right.

Pluralistic: Wage Theft

[就是这样。这就是核心所在。如果你认为财产权是实现人权的工具，那么你就是左翼。你可能会支持农民有权阻止为了建造数据中心而通过国家征用权（eminent domain）征收土地的企图，或者支持人们免受警察搜查住宅或设备的权利，或者支持图书馆拥有和归档数字图书的权利——即便出版商坚称电子书从不被“出售”、而仅仅被“许可”。]

That's it. That's the crux. If you think that property rights are a tool for achieving human rights, then you're on the left. You might support the right of farmers to block attempts to expropriate them via eminent domain in order to build a data center, or the right of people to not have their homes or devices searched by cops, or a library's right to own and archive digital books, even if the publishers insist that ebooks are never "sold," merely "licensed."

[如果财产权是实现人权的工具，那么当财产权阻碍其他权利时，它们就可以被搁置。人类有权获得医疗保健，这就是为什么我们应该剥夺制药公司的专利和版权，结束疫苗种族隔离，让贫穷的世界能够制造自己的疫苗：]

If property rights are a tool to achieve human rights, then property rights can be set aside when they impede other rights. Human beings have the right to health care, which is why we should have taken away the pharma companies' patents and copyrights, ending vaccine apartheid and letting the poor world make its own vaccines:

Pluralistic: The Other Shoe Drops

[人类有权获得住所。如果你所在的城镇有一百万套空置的房屋和一百万个无家可归的人，那么答案是显而易见的。至少，你可以对空置房屋征收重税，以遏制荒废、空置的烂尾现象的蔓延：]

Human beings have the right to shelter. If your town has a million empty homes and a million homeless people, there's an obvious solution. At the very least, you can tax the shit out of empty homes to discourage the creation of derelict, empty blights:

Liverpool Echo

[人类有权获得食物。如果某个卡特尔垄断组织宣称你不得合法出售你的10万磅油桃，你完全可以把它们免费送人，并让那个卡特尔滚蛋：]

Human beings have the right to food. If a cartel claims that you may not legally sell your 100,000lbs of nectarines, you can just give them away and tell the cartel to fuck off:

AP News

[正如布鲁斯特所说，这场斗争和法国大革命一样古老。这简直就是《悲惨世界》的剧情（“昔日岁月里，我曾为了生存偷过一条面包”）。]

As Brust says, this fight is as old as the French Revolution. It's literally the plot of Les Mis ("In days gone by, I stole a loaf of bread in order to live").

[需要注意的是，这种框架为左翼内部的分歧留出了充足的空间：我们可以就谁应该纳税以及如何纳税、何时应责令一家公司销毁其不义之财以及何时应将这些财物分给受害者、如何处理空置房屋和无家可归者等问题产生分歧。我们可以就赔偿、集体化和合作社、土地改革等议题争论不休。极少数（极少数！）左翼分子想要废除财产，但要做一个左翼分子，就必须认同财产永远只是一种手段，绝非目的。]

Note that this framework leaves plenty of room for disagreement among leftists: we can disagree about who should get taxed and how, when a company should be ordered to destroy its ill-gotten loot and when that loot should be divided up among its victims, and what to do about empty houses and homeless people. We can disagree about reparations, about collectivization and co-operatives, about land reform. Very (very!) few leftists want to abolish property, but to be a leftist is to agree that property is only ever a means, and never an end.

[在系统思维中，我们被告知，最深远、最持久的变化来自于范式（paradigms）的转变，所有的规则、法律和安排都源于这些范式：]

In systems thinking, we are counseled that the most profound and durable changes come from shifts in paradigms, from which all rules, laws and arrangements flow:

Pluralistic: Donella Meadows

[“左翼”和“右翼”代表着两种截然不同的范式。右翼的范式是：财产权就是人权，这最终演变为“财产权是唯一的人权”。如果财产权就是人权，那么我就可以烧掉自己的果园，并在你饿死在门外时放声大笑。如果财产权就是人权，我就可以让一栋公寓楼空置，而你在其人行道上冻死。如果财产权就是人权，我可以在我的工厂里布满夺命的陷阱，并坚信我所杀害的工人们是自愿承担这种风险的（正如经济学家所说，他们在工作中有“显示的偏好”（revealed preference）被杀死）：]

"Left" and "right" represent two radically different paradigms. The right's paradigm is that property rights are human rights, which cashes out to "property rights are the only human right." If property rights are a human right, then I can burn down my orchard and laugh as you starve outside the gates. If property rights are human rights, I can leave an apartment building empty while you freeze to death on its sidewalk. If property rights are human rights, I can fill my factory with death-traps and insist that the workers I kill freely chose to assume that risk (as economists would say, they have a "revealed preference" for being killed at work):

Pluralistic: Players of Games

[左翼则将财产权视为一种工具，就像法律、规章、民意调查或投票一样。运用得当，这些工具能够为所有人带来繁荣。但“投票”和“法律”本身并非至善。瑞士通过投票决定你的邻居是否具备公民资格的做法是野蛮的：]

Leftists view property rights as a tool, like laws, or regulations, or polls, or voting. Used well, these tools can produce prosperity for all. But "voting" and "laws" aren't good unto themselves. The Swiss practice of voting on whether your neighbors qualify for citizenship is barbaric:

BBC News

优秀的规章和法律固然是好事，但盲目通过任何法律则是愚蠢的，这会让你陷入极大的麻烦，即便你通过的那条愚蠢法律旨在解决一个真正的问题：]

Good regulations and laws are good, but simply passing any law is stupid and gets you into terrible trouble, even if the stupid law you've passed is designed to solve a real problem:

Pluralistic: Destroy the Village

[如果将财产权视为工具，它们便是实现文明核心宗旨——保障人民人权——的极其有用的方式。如果将财产权视为自身的目的，那么它们对我们的文明和物种将是可怕的威胁。]

Viewed as tools, property rights are perfectly useful ways of achieving the primary purpose of a civilization: to safeguard the human rights of its people. Viewed as ends unto themselves, property rights are a terrible danger to our civilization and species.

[如果你认为财产权是工具，你就可以通过法律禁止企业进行选举宣传：]

If you believe property rights are tools, then you can pass laws banning corporations from electioneering:

Minnesota Election Laws

[如果你认为财产权是人权，你最终就会支持在选举中进行无限制的黑金（dark money）政治捐款：]

If you believe property rights are human rights, then you end up supporting unlimited dark money spending in elections:

Supreme Court Opinion

[如果你认为财产权是工具，你就可以命令那些想禁止租户安装阳台太阳能电池板的房东滚蛋。如果你认为财产权是人权，那么房东就可以强迫其租客支付化石燃料行业所要求的每一分钱。“财产权作为工具”的观点，既能让你捍卫农民安装风力发电场的权利，又能阻止数据中心在自己的土地上安装燃气轮机。]

If you believe property rights are tools, you can order landlords who want to ban their tenants from installing balcony solar to fuck off. If you believe property rights are human rights, then landlords can force their tenants to pay every dime the fossil fuel industry demands of them. "Property right as tool" allows you to defend a farmer's right to install a wind-farm, and still, to block a data-center from installing a gas turbine on its own land.

[“后政治”运动由那些根本不懂什么是政治的人组成。“温和派”归根结底就是右翼，因为右翼的基石是财产至上。正是这种意识形态滋生了世袭贵族制（“财产权是人权”意味着，如果你从一个幸运的器官里出生，却期望你靠工作谋生，那就是对你人权的侵犯）。正是这种意识形态滋生了寡头政治。]

"Post-political" movements are made up of people who don't know what politics are. A "centrist" is ultimately a rightist, because the foundation of rightism is the supremacy of property. It is the ideology that breeds hereditary aristocracy ("property is a human right" means that it's a violation of your human rights to expect you to work for a living if you emerged from a lucky orifice). It's the ideology that breeds oligarchy.

[政治不是一堆文化符号或身份标记。政治无关乎谁在统治——而关乎我们是否受到统治，或者我们是否自由。]

Politics aren't a bunch of cultural signifiers or identity markers. Politics aren't about who rules – it's about whether we are ruled at all, or whether we are free.

(图片：刘易斯·克拉克，CC BY-SA 2.0，经修改)

items.title: 寻找 Apple Upgrade 的陷阱
path: 寻找 Apple Upgrade 的陷阱

items.title: 背景与摘要
items.text: 本文剖析了近期针对由Klarna提供支持的苹果新“Apple Upgrade”分期计划的批评意见。尽管有批评者因为该计划在法律上属于“租赁”性质而将其贴上“陷阱”的标签，但本文认为该计划的条款是透明且公平的。所谓的“陷阱”其实只是一种消费心理学：这种租赁结构确实鼓励用户每两年更新一次硬件，而不是最终买断设备，但它本身在财务上并没有对消费者施加惩罚（零利息），仅仅是为高端硬件提供了一条月供更低的获取途径。
path: 寻找 Apple Upgrade 的陷阱

items.title: Summary
items.text:
本文审视了近期对苹果新的“Apple Upgrade”计划——一项由 Klarna 促成的租赁安排——的批评。虽然一些批评者因为该计划的结构是租赁而不是传统贷款，就将其贴上了“陷阱”的标签，但该分析认为，这项计划是透明的，且提供了公平的条款。人们所认为的“陷阱”仅仅是一个消费者心理学问题：这种结构鼓励用户每两年更新一次硬件，而不是还清设备款，但它并没有在财务上本质性地惩罚消费者。

This article examines recent criticisms of Apple’s new "Apple Upgrade" program—a leasing arrangement facilitated by Klarna. While some critics label the program a "trap" due to its structure as a lease rather than a traditional loan, this analysis argues that the program is transparent and offers fair terms. The perceived "trap" is simply a matter of consumer psychology: the structure encourages users to refresh their hardware every two years rather than paying off the device, but it does not inherently penalize the consumer financially.
path: 寻找 Apple Upgrade 的陷阱

items.title: The "Lease vs. Loan" Confusion
items.text:
Damon Beres 在为《大西洋月刊》撰写的文章中，最近将苹果新的租赁计划描绘成一个“陷阱”，并指出，与传统的“先买后付”服务（或传统的 iPhone 年年焕新计划，iPhone Upgrade Program）不同，Apple Upgrade 在法律上是一项租赁。在这种模式下，硬件在付清最后一笔款项之前并不属于用户。

Damon Beres, writing for The Atlantic, recently characterized Apple’s new leasing program as a "trap," noting that unlike traditional buy-now, pay-later services (or the legacy iPhone Upgrade Program), Apple Upgrade is legally a lease. Under this model, the hardware does not belong to the user until the final payment is made.

然而，这种区别可以说比批评者所暗示的要清晰得多。Apple Upgrade 是主要品牌，而与 Klarna 的合作是一种标准的财务安排。将它与其他零售融资进行比较是很直观的：它就是一个租赁计划，一旦明白了这一点，条款就是透明的。

However, this distinction is arguably clearer than critics suggest. Apple Upgrade is the primary brand, and the partnership with Klarna is a standard financial arrangement. Comparing it to other retail financing is straightforward: it is a leasing program, and once that is understood, the terms are transparent.
path: 寻找 Apple Upgrade 的陷阱

items.title: Addressing the "Trap" Narrative
items.text:
批评的核心在于将苹果的租赁条款与传统的零售贷款（例如百思买 Best Buy 提供的贷款）进行比较。批评者指出，在 24 个月的租期结束时，用户可能仍欠下一大笔“气球”付款（尾款）才能彻底拥有该设备。

The core of the criticism lies in a comparison between Apple’s leasing terms and traditional retail loans (such as those offered by Best Buy). Critics point out that at the end of a 24-month lease, a user may still owe a significant "balloon" payment to own the device outright.

此处的分析澄清了一个简单的事实：价格差异是由零售定价驱动的，而不是掠夺性贷款。

The analysis here clarifies a simple reality: the price difference is driven by retail pricing, not predatory lending. * 百思买 (Best Buy): 对售价为 1,849 美元的设备提供 18 个月的贷款。 * Best Buy: Offers an 18-month loan on a device priced at $1,849. * 苹果 (Apple): 对售价为 1,999 美元的设备提供 24 个月的租赁。 * Apple: Offers a 24-month lease on a device priced at $1,999.

苹果的安排导致总成本更高，这一事实仅仅是因为该机器的零售价格更高。Apple Upgrade 计划中并不涉及任何利息惩罚。

The fact that the Apple arrangement results in a higher total cost is simply because the retail price of the machine is higher. There is no interest penalty involved in the Apple Upgrade program.
path: 寻找 Apple Upgrade 的陷阱

items.title: Is It Really a Trap?
items.text:
关于 Apple Upgrade 是“陷阱”的论点在于，认为用户会感到有压力去开始一项新的租赁，而不是支付剩余的余额来拥有他们使用两年的旧设备。

The argument that Apple Upgrade is a "trap" rests on the idea that users will feel pressured to start a new lease rather than pay the remaining balance to own their two-year-old device.

虽然确实该计划被设计为鼓励永无止境的升级循环——这有利于苹果的底线（利润）——但称其为陷阱未免有些牵强。消费者没有被欺骗；他们只是被提供了一条以低月供途径来获取高端硬件的路径。一个人是选择付清设备款还是将其折抵换购最新型号，完全是个人偏好问题，而不是一个掠夺性的金融陷阱。

While it is true that the program is designed to encourage a cycle of perpetual upgrading—which benefits Apple’s bottom line—it is a stretch to call this a trap. Consumers are not being deceived; they are being offered a low-monthly-payment path to access high-end hardware. Whether one chooses to pay off the device or trade it in for the latest model is a matter of personal preference, not a predatory financial snare.

归根结底，如果你看重彻底拥有你的科技产品，传统的购买途径仍然适用。如果你更喜欢较低的每月成本，并且喜欢能够循环使用新硬件，那么这种租赁就是一个实用的、免息的工具。

Ultimately, if you value owning your tech outright, the traditional purchase route remains available. If you prefer lower monthly costs and the ability to cycle through new hardware, the lease is a functional, interest-free tool.

来源: Daring Fireball

items.title: 将 TCP 连接分配给 Linux 流量控制的 'Flows'
path: 将 TCP 连接分配给 Linux 流量控制的 'Flows'

items.title: 背景与摘要
items.text: 本文探讨了如何使用 Linux 的 tc (流量控制) 工具将来自单个 IP 地址的 HTTPS 流量聚合成单个“流 (flows)”。文章记录了作者为了对发出带宽实施限制而进行的网络配置实验。作者使用 tc-flow 替代了通常的 tc-sfq 来实现更精细的分组控制，详细介绍了两种配置方法：基于目标 IP 进行哈希计算分组，以及基于 /24 网络前缀进行映射分组。最后，文章指出了该方法面临的难题：难以监控验证过滤器是否按照预期正确地对流量进行了分配。
path: 将 TCP 连接分配给 Linux 流量控制的 'Flows'

items.title: Summary
items.text:
本文探讨了使用 Linux 的 tc (流量控制) 实用程序将来自各个 IP 地址的 HTTPS 流量聚合成单个“流”所面临的挑战。虽然 tc-sfq 通常用于公平排队，但作者尝试使用 tc-flow 来获得对连接分组方式更精细的控制。文章详细介绍了两种具体的配置方法——按 IP 哈希以及按网络前缀映射——同时指出，要验证这些过滤器是否成功影响了流量分类是非常困难的。

This article explores the challenge of aggregating HTTPS traffic from individual IP addresses into single "flows" using Linux's tc (traffic control) utility. While tc-sfq is typically used for fair queuing, the author experiments with tc-flow to gain more granular control over how connections are grouped. The post details two specific configuration approaches—hashing by IP and mapping by network prefix—while noting the difficulty in verifying whether these filters are successfully influencing traffic classification.
path: 将 TCP 连接分配给 Linux 流量控制的 'Flows'

items.title: Background
items.text:
在之前限制 Web 服务器出站带宽的工作中，目标是将来自单一 IP 地址的所有 HTTPS 请求聚合成一个“流”，交由 tc-sfq(8) 处理。尽管 tc-flow(8) 正是为了这个目的而设计的，但其语法以难以驾驭而闻名。

In previous efforts to limit outgoing bandwidth for a web server, the goal was to aggregate all HTTPS requests from a single IP address into one "flow" for tc-sfq(8). Although tc-flow(8) is designed for this purpose, the syntax is notoriously difficult to navigate.
path: 将 TCP 连接分配给 Linux 流量控制的 'Flows'

items.title: Configuration Setup
items.text:
下面的 class 用作受带宽限制流量的基础：

The following class is used as the foundation for the bandwidth-limited traffic:

tc class add dev eno1 parent 1: classid 1:10 htb rate 400mbit ceil 500mbit prio 10
path: 将 TCP 连接分配给 Linux 流量控制的 'Flows'

items.title: Approach 1: Hashing by IP
items.text:
为了根据目标 IP 聚合流量，我们使用了哈希过滤器。handle 参数对于过滤器被内核接受至关重要。

To aggregate traffic based on the destination IP, we use a hash filter. The handle parameter is critical for the filter to be accepted by the kernel.

tc filter add dev eno1 protocol ip parent 1:10 handle 20 flow hash keys src,dst,proto,proto-src divisor 4096
  • 逻辑： 由于 Web 服务器传出流量的源 IP、协议和源端口是恒定的，这有效地迫使流量由目标 IP 决定。
    • Logic: Since the source IP, protocol, and source port are constant for a web server's outgoing traffic, this effectively forces the flow to be determined by the destination IP.
  • 注意： 我们避免使用 perturb 来确保流量保持“粘性”，并使用一个较大的除数 (divisor) 以容纳大量并发连接。
    • Note: We avoid perturb to ensure flows remain "sticky" and use a large divisor to accommodate a high volume of concurrent connections.
path: 将 TCP 连接分配给 Linux 流量控制的 'Flows'

items.title: Approach 2: Mapping by Network Prefix (/24)
items.text:
为了更激进的聚合，可以使用 map 过滤器将目标 IP 按照 /24 子网进行分组：

For more aggressive aggregation, one can group traffic by the destination's /24 subnet using a map filter:

tc filter add dev eno1 protocol ip parent 1:10 handle 20 flow map key dst rshift 8 divisor 4096
  • 逻辑： 通过将目标 IP 右移 8 位，我们有效地隔离了前三个八位字节，从而按子网对流量进行分组。
    • Logic: By right-shifting the destination IP by 8 bits, we effectively isolate the first three octets, grouping traffic by subnet.
path: 将 TCP 连接分配给 Linux 流量控制的 'Flows'

items.title: Integration with tc-sfq
items.text:
为了确保排队规则与过滤器匹配，sfq qdisc（排队规则）必须配置为具有相匹配的流数量：

To ensure the queueing discipline matches the filter, the sfq qdisc must be configured with a matching number of flows:

tc qdisc add dev eno1 parent 1:10 handle 10: sfq flows 4096 divisor 4096
path: 将 TCP 连接分配给 Linux 流量控制的 'Flows'

items.title: Challenges and Observations
items.text:
首要障碍是可观测性。没有标准的方法来检查特定连接被分配到了哪个流，这使得很难验证过滤器是否如预期般运行。

The primary obstacle is observability. There is no standard way to inspect which flow a specific connection has been assigned to, making it difficult to verify if the filters are functioning as intended.

作者指出：

The author notes: * 尚不清楚过滤器应该附加到类 (parent 1:10) 还是直接附加到 sfq qdisc (parent 10:)。 * It is unclear whether the filters should be attached to the class (parent 1:10) or directly to the sfq qdisc (parent 10:). * 使用 iftop 的初步测试表明流过滤器可能没有执行预期的聚合，尽管仍难以获得明确的证实。 * Initial testing with iftop suggests that the flow filters may not be performing the intended aggregation, though definitive confirmation remains elusive.
path: 将 TCP 连接分配给 Linux 流量控制的 'Flows'

items.title: 小工具评测：Thermal Master DV2 - 红外线观鸟望远镜 ★★★★½
items.text: 背景与摘要： Thermal Master DV2 是一款专为观鸟和寻找动物而设计的专用热成像及红外线摄像机。该设备摒弃了传统单筒望远镜典型的目镜加橡胶按钮设计，转而采用了一块明亮且反应灵敏的触摸屏，并配备了可更换电池系统。虽然它在操作上有一些小怪癖——例如需要点击屏幕来捕捉媒体内容，而不是配备专用的物理快门按钮——但它却能提供令人印象深刻的红外成像清晰度、多功能的 AI 画质提升、RTSP 流媒体传输功能，以及远超许多竞品的出色用户体验。目前该设备售价为 459 英镑（使用代码 THERMBIRD10 可享 9 折优惠）。
path: 小工具评测：Thermal Master DV2 - 红外线观鸟望远镜 ★★★★½

items.title: Summary
items.text: The Thermal Master DV2 is a dedicated thermal and infrared camera designed specifically for birdwatching and animal spotting. Eschewing the traditional eyepiece-and-rubber-button design of typical monoculars, the DV2 features a bright, responsive touchscreen and a swappable battery system. While it has minor quirks—such as requiring on-screen taps to capture media rather than a dedicated physical shutter button—it delivers impressive thermal clarity, versatile AI upscaling, RTSP streaming capabilities, and a user experience that outshines much of the competition. It is available now for £459 (with a 10% discount using code THERMBIRD10).

items.title: 简介
items.text:
Thermal Master 的好心人寄来了他们的 DV2 摄像机 供我评测。这是一款专为野生动物爱好者和寻找动物的人士量身定制的设备，让我们来测试一下它的性能，看看它与竞品相比究竟如何。

一眼就能看出，它有别于标准的红外线摄像机，后者通常配备一个小巧的固定屏幕和橡胶按钮界面。而 DV2 则拥有一块华丽的触摸屏，不仅能显示热成像画面，还能作为主要的控制中心。该屏幕的亮度足以在充足的日光下清晰观看，同时也可以调暗，以便在夜间隐蔽使用。

Straight away, you can see it differs from standard IR cameras, which usually feature a small fixed screen and a rubber button interface. The DV2 boasts a lush touchscreen that displays the thermal image and acts as the primary control center. The screen is bright enough for full daylight viewing and can be dimmed for discreet night-time use.
path: 小工具评测：Thermal Master DV2 - 红外线观鸟望远镜 ★★★★½

items.title: 正面交锋：DV2 对比 Topdon TS004
items.text:
与 Topdon TS004 热成像单筒望远镜 相比：

  • 显示屏/界面: TS004 需要你把眼睛贴紧目镜，并用力按下物理橡胶按钮。而 DV2 则提供了一个更加舒适、宽大的触摸屏界面。
  • 分辨率: 两者都配备了标准的 256×192 传感器，但 DV2 却得益于非常有效的 AI 画质提升技术。
  • 其他附加功能: DV2 内置了激光笔、标准三脚架底座，支持 Wi-Fi 固件更新以及直接 RTSP 流媒体传输。奇怪的是，它还包含一个可选的 皮卡汀尼导轨 (Picatinny Rail) 适配器，用于安装枪支配件或测距仪。
  • 电池: DV2 使用一块可拆卸的 1INR22/71 电池，并配有一个外部双槽桌面充电器，方便轻松进行热插拔。
  • 动物识别: TS004 具备内置的动物分类功能，不过它曾出过将英国狐狸错误识别为野猪的著名乌龙事件。DV2 舍弃了不可靠的分类功能，转而专注于清晰的 AI 图像放大。
  • Display/Interface: The TS004 requires you to press your eye against an eyepiece and mash physical rubber buttons. The DV2 provides a much more comfortable, large, touchscreen interface.
  • Resolution: Both feature standard 256×192 sensors, though the DV2 benefits from effective AI upscaling.
  • Extras: The DV2 includes a built-in laser pointer, a standard tripod mount, Wi-Fi firmware updates, and direct RTSP streaming. Bizarrely, it also includes an optional Picatinny Rail adaptor for mounting firearm accessories or range-finders.
  • Battery: The DV2 uses a removable 1INR22/71 battery with an external dual-slot desktop charger, allowing for easy hot-swapping.
  • Animal Recognition: The TS004 features built-in animal classification, though it famously misidentified UK foxes as Wild Boars. The DV2 skips unreliable classification in favor of clean AI image upscaling.

items.text:

If you want to step up your wildlife observation game, this is the device to get.

items.title: 就是今天，OpenAI 搞砸了 ChatGPT Mac 应用
items.text:
背景与摘要： 本文批评了 OpenAI 最近针对 macOS 桌面端 ChatGPT 应用的更新。原来小巧、原生的 ChatGPT 应用程序被降级为“ChatGPT Classic”，取而代之的是一个体积庞大、基于 Electron 框架构建的“超级应用”。新应用将多种工具（包括已停用的 Atlas 浏览器功能）强行拼凑在一起，不仅体积膨胀至 1.5GB，而且完全背离了原生 Mac 应用的设计美学，引发了用户的强烈不满。

Summary: OpenAI’s latest sprawling product announcements have completely upended the macOS desktop experience. The beloved native ChatGPT app has been relegated to "Classic" status, replaced by a bloated 1.5 GB Electron "superapp" that awkwardly merges multiple tools—including remnants of the discontinued Atlas browser—while abandoning native Mac design principles.
path: 就是今天，OpenAI 搞砸了 ChatGPT Mac 应用

items.title: 全新的桌面生态系统
items.text:
Zac Hall 在 9to5Mac 撰文，总结了这场混乱的过渡：

看来我挑错了一周来戒掉吸胶水的恶习。

Looks like I picked the wrong week to quit sniffing glue.
path: 就是今天，OpenAI 搞砸了 ChatGPT Mac 应用

items.title: The New Desktop Ecosystem
items.text:
Writing at 9to5Mac, Zac Hall summarized the chaotic transition:

总结一下今天的桌面应用变化：

  • 现有的 ChatGPT 应用现在变成了 ChatGPT Classic。
  • Codex 现在成了新的 ChatGPT 桌面应用。它看起来仍然像 Codex，并且包含 Codex 图标作为一个选项，但现在它被称为 ChatGPT。
  • 用于桌面的 ChatGPT 包含 ChatGPT Work 和 ChatGPT Codex，两者共享插件。ChatGPT Codex 模式会显示更多 ChatGPT Work 向用户隐藏的技术细节。
  • 你可以同时安装 ChatGPT Classic、ChatGPT 和 Codex，但未来的发展方向似乎是只运行新的 ChatGPT 桌面应用。Codex 用户仍然可以使用 Codex 应用图标，但应用名称将变为 ChatGPT。

To summarize today’s desktop app changes:

  • The existing ChatGPT app is now ChatGPT Classic.
  • Codex is now the new ChatGPT desktop app. It still looks like Codex and includes the Codex icon as an option, but it’s now called ChatGPT.
  • ChatGPT for desktop includes ChatGPT Work and ChatGPT Codex, which share plug-ins. ChatGPT Codex mode shows more technical details that ChatGPT Work abstracts away from the user.
  • It’s possible to have ChatGPT Classic, ChatGPT, and Codex installed, but the way forward seems to be just running the new ChatGPT desktop app. Codex users can still use the Codex app icon, but the app will be called ChatGPT.
path: 就是今天，OpenAI 搞砸了 ChatGPT Mac 应用

items.title: 原生优雅与 Electron 臃肿的对决
items.text:
ChatGPT Classic 应用程序看起来更像原生 Mac 风格，所以对用户来说这可能是一个问题。

存在已久的原生 ChatGPT Mac 应用程序——也就是现在显然被称为 ChatGPT Classic 的那个——是一个仅有 159 MB 的小巧程序包。

The longstanding native ChatGPT Mac app—the one apparently now called ChatGPT Classic—is a modest 159 MB bundle.

相比之下，新的 ChatGPT 超级应用——结合了简单的聊天机器人、ChatGPT Work、Codex 以及已停止独立的 Atlas Web 浏览器的残余部分——膨胀成了一个体积达 1.5 GB 的 Electron 怪物，这听起来一点也不“超级”。

In contrast, the new ChatGPT superapp—which combines the simple chatbot, ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the remnants of the now-discontinued Atlas standalone web browser—collapses into a svelte 1.5 GB Electron bundle, which doesn’t sound "super" at all.

items.title: 带回终端机：实体媒体的愿景
path: 带回终端机：实体媒体的愿景

items.title: 背景与摘要
items.text: 随着游戏产业加速向纯数字发行转型，实体媒体收藏家们正在哀叹实体游戏的消失。本文回顾了20世纪90年代英国的一个名为 EDOS（软件电子分发）的终端机系统，该系统允许零售商根据需求当场将游戏刻录到磁盘或磁带上。通过重新审视这项技术，文章探讨了在当今数字与实体并行发展的时代，零售商能否通过类似的按需复制模式来解决库存问题。
path: 带回终端机：实体媒体的愿景

items.title: Summary
items.text:
随着游戏产业积极转向纯数字发行，实体媒体爱好者正在哀叹实体收藏的流失。本文探讨了 EDOS（软件电子分发）的历史，这是一个 20 世纪 90 年代位于英国的自助终端系统，它允许零售商根据需求将游戏刻录到光盘或磁带上。通过重新审视这项“如果……会怎样”的技术，我们思考现代零售业是否可以通过采用类似的按需复制模式来解决其库存困境。

As the gaming industry shifts aggressively toward digital-only distribution, physical media enthusiasts are mourning the loss of tangible collections. This article explores the history of EDOS (Electronic Distribution of Software), a 1990s UK-based kiosk system that allowed retailers to burn games onto discs or cassettes on demand. By revisiting this "what-if" technology, we consider whether modern retail could solve its inventory woes by adopting similar on-demand duplication models.
path: 带回终端机：实体媒体的愿景

items.title: The Problem with Modern Retail
items.text:
走进一家现代游戏商店通常会感觉像是一种受限的体验。虽然网站提供了跨越几十年游戏历史的庞大作品库，但实体商店的货架仅限于当前一代游戏机的最新发布版本。

Walking into a modern game store often feels like a restricted experience. While websites offer a vast library of titles spanning decades of gaming history, physical store shelves are limited to the latest releases for current-gen consoles.

该行业已经远离了实体媒体，但底层技术——CD、DVD 和蓝光光盘——仍然是标准化的。这提出了一个引人注目的问题：为什么零售商不能简单地按需刻录游戏？ 这种系统在理论上可以支持从现代 PlayStation 和 Xbox 游戏到世嘉土星或 Dreamcast 等被遗忘已久的经典游戏的一切。

The industry has moved away from physical media, but the underlying technology—CDs, DVDs, and Blu-rays—remains standardized. This raises a compelling question: Why can’t retailers simply burn games on demand? Such a system could theoretically support everything from modern PlayStation and Xbox titles to long-forgotten classics for the Sega Saturn or Dreamcast.
path: 带回终端机：实体媒体的愿景

items.title: The EDOS Precedent
items.text:
在 20 世纪 90 年代初期，英国面临着类似的困境。像 Amstrad CPC、Commodore 64 和 ZX Spectrum 这样的家用电脑很受欢迎，但为特定、不太常见的格式寻找软件却很困难。

In the early 1990s, the UK faced a similar dilemma. Home computers like the Amstrad CPC, Commodore 64, and ZX Spectrum were popular, but finding software for specific, less-common formats was difficult.

Software on Demand Ltd 及其 EDOS 系统 应运而生。这些安装在 John Menzies 等零售商中的庞大机器，是那个时代的奇迹：

Enter Software on Demand Ltd and their EDOS system. These hulking machines, installed in retailers like John Menzies, were marvels of their time: * 多功能性： 配备了软盘驱动器、CD-ROM 驱动器和高速磁带录音机。 * Versatility: Equipped with floppy drives, CD-ROM drives, and high-speed cassette recorders. * 跨平台： 能够为各种家用电脑和早期游戏机复制软件。 * Cross-Platform: Capable of duplicating software for various home computers and early consoles. * 高效： 该系统自动验证每份副本，显著降低了缺陷退货率。 * Efficiency: The system verified each copy automatically, significantly reducing the rate of defective returns.

尽管该公司最终在 1994 年关闭，但 EDOS 系统证明了消费者愿意接受“销售点”制造。这是一个具有前瞻性的解决方案，或许只是超前了几年。

Though the company eventually shuttered in 1994, the EDOS system proved that consumers were willing to embrace "point-of-sale" manufacturing. It was a forward-thinking solution that was perhaps just a few years ahead of its time.
path: 带回终端机：实体媒体的愿景

items.title: Could It Work Today?
items.text:
虽然旧游戏的版权管理仍然是一个重大障碍，但现代版 EDOS 的技术基础设施比以往任何时候都更加可行。借助大容量蓝光光盘和高速数字发行，现代自助终端可以轻松处理当今游戏的庞大文件尺寸。

While the rights management for older titles remains a significant hurdle, the technical infrastructure for a modern version of EDOS is more feasible than ever. With high-capacity Blu-ray discs and high-speed digital distribution, a modern kiosk could easily handle the massive file sizes of today’s games.

也许实体媒体的未来不是货架上预先包装好的盒子，而是重返终端机——这是一种在拥抱数字发行便利性的同时，保留拥有实体副本乐趣的方式。

Perhaps the future of physical media isn't pre-packaged boxes on a shelf, but a return to the kiosk—a way to preserve the joy of owning a physical copy while embracing the convenience of digital distribution.
path: 带回终端机：实体媒体的愿景

items.title: 背景与摘要
items.text: 本文是包管理器分析系列文章的第一篇，专门探讨 Zig 的内置包管理器。Zig 采用了一种去中心化的方式，不依赖中央注册表，而是直接基于源码托管平台和内容哈希（通过 build.zig.zon 文件）进行包分发。这种方法虽然保证了构建的强可重复性，但也带来了一些挑战，如自定义格式解析困难、图灵完备的构建脚本带来的安全隐患以及缺乏依赖覆盖机制等。总体而言，Zig 的包管理理念独特，但在生态系统的治理和安全补丁管理上仍有改进空间。

items.title: Summary
items.text:
本文是系列文章的第一篇，该系列根据涵盖客户端设计、注册表架构、治理和威胁模型的标准化标准，对各个包管理器进行分析。

This post is the first in a series analyzing individual package managers against a standardized set of criteria covering client design, registry architecture, governance, and threat models.

Zig 的内置包管理器摒弃了中央注册表，转而采用源主机分发方式，通过 build.zig.zon 清单将内容哈希作为不可变的包标识符。虽然这种方法提供了强大的可重复性并避免了中央治理瓶颈，但它也带来了独特的挑战：定制的 Zig 对象表示法 (.zon) 格式需要跨生态系统的自定义解析器，图灵完备的构建脚本无法通过安全安装的“星期二测试”，而且缺乏传递性覆盖机制使安全补丁变得复杂。

Zig’s built-in package manager eliminates central registries in favor of source-host distribution, using content hashes as immutable package identifiers via build.zig.zon manifests. While this approach offers strong reproducibility and avoids central governance bottlenecks, it creates unique challenges: the bespoke Zig Object Notation (.zon) format requires custom cross-ecosystem parsers, Turing-complete build scripts fail the "Tuesday test" for secure installations, and the absence of a transitive override mechanism complicates security patching.

items.title: Overview
items.text:
自 2023 年 8 月的 0.11 版本起，Zig 的包管理器就内置在 zig 二进制文件中，无需单独的工具或中央注册表即可运行。build.zig.zon 文件将依赖项列为带有内容哈希的 URL，而 zig build 则将它们全部获取并编译在一起。该语言和工具均由 501©(3) 非营利组织 Zig 软件基金会管理。

Zig’s package manager has been built into the zig binary since 0.11 in August 2023, operating without a separate tool or central registry. A build.zig.zon file lists dependencies as URLs with content hashes, and zig build fetches and compiles everything together. Both the language and the tool are managed by the Zig Software Foundation, a 501©(3) non-profit.

items.title: How it Works
items.text:
Zig 项目通常在其根目录下包含两个核心文件：

A Zig project typically contains two core files at its root: 1. build.zig: 编译和执行任意 Zig 代码，以描述目标、编译标志并链接依赖项。 1. build.zig: Arbitrary Zig code compiled and executed to describe targets, compile flags, and link dependencies. 2. build.zig.zon: 惰性元数据和依赖数据，无需执行代码即可解析。 2. build.zig.zon: Inert metadata and dependency data that can be parsed without executing code.

.{
    .name = .example,
    .version = "0.3.1",
    .fingerprint = 0x6a8091f57c7f07ff,
    .minimum_zig_version = "0.16.0",
    .dependencies = .{
        .known_folders = .{
            .url = "https://github.com/ziglibs/known-folders/archive/refs/tags/1.1.0.tar.gz",
            .hash = "known_folders-1.1.0-Fy-PJtnVAAC1Qq48Hf6_4er0Ku98mFvx99UUwo9-mrJd",
        },
        .tracy = .{
            .url = "git+https://github.com/wolfpld/tracy#v0.11.1",
            .hash = "N-V-__8AAKw3UgOhKDsrn8hRlOoGmVBl5x91fMi0WQwVaokf",
            .lazy = true,
        },
    },
    .paths = .{
        "build.zig",
        "build.zig.zon",
        "src",
        "LICENSE",
    },
}

  • ZON (Zig Object Notation): Zig 语法的子集，仅限于字面量和匿名结构体，缺乏表达式、导入或函数调用（参见规范）。

    • ZON (Zig Object Notation): A subset of Zig’s syntax restricted to literals and anonymous structs, lacking expressions, imports, or function calls (see the specification).

  • Fingerprint: 一个 64 位整数，结合了随机的 32 位 ID 和包名的校验和，作为独立于 URL 的永久身份。

    • Fingerprint: A 64-bit integer combining a random 32-bit ID with a checksum of the package name, acting as a permanent identity independent of URLs.

  • Content Addressing: 在应用 .paths 包含列表后，对提取的文件计算哈希值。正如文档所指出的：“包不是来自 url；它们来自 hash。url 只是众多可能镜像中的一个。”

    • Content Addressing: Hashes are computed over extracted files after applying the .paths inclusion list. As the documentation notes: "packages do not come from a url; they come from a hash. url is just one of many possible mirrors."

  • Build Integration: zig build 将 build.zig 与每个依赖项的构建脚本一起编译为一个可执行文件，这意味着传递依赖项在同一个进程中运行，而不是在单独的子进程中运行。

    • Build Integration: zig build compiles build.zig alongside every dependency's build script into a single executable, meaning transitive dependencies run in the same process rather than separate subprocesses.

items.title: Client
items.text:
• Resolution Algorithm: 无。每个清单都固定确切的内容哈希，没有版本范围，这最接近显式依赖模型（如 Nix 或 Guix），尽管没有内容寻址存储。

    • Resolution Algorithm: None. Each manifest pins exact content hashes with no version ranges, aligning closest to the explicit-dependencies bucket (like Nix or Guix), albeit without a content-addressed store.

  • Lockfile: 清单本身就是锁文件（build.zig.zon），它递归地固定内容哈希。无需单独的锁文件即可重现，类似于 Go。

    • Lockfile: The manifest is the lock file (build.zig.zon), pinning content hashes recursively. Reproducible without a separate lockfile, akin to Go.

  • Build Hooks: 允许。build.zig 在构建时执行代码，类似于 Cargo 的 build.rs 或 Swift 的 Package.swift。

    • Build Hooks: Allowed. build.zig executes code at build time, similar to Cargo’s build.rs or Swift’s Package.swift.

  • Tuesday Test: 未通过。由于 build.zig 是图灵完备的，安装过程可能会出现未声明的输入。

    • Tuesday Test: Fails. Installs can observe undeclared inputs because build.zig is Turing-complete.

  • Manifest Format: 元数据采用自定义格式（.zon），构建逻辑采用宿主语言（build.zig）。由于 .zon 是定制的，像 ecosyste.ms 和 git-pkgs 这样的跨生态系统工具必须实现自定义解析器。

    • Manifest Format: Custom for metadata (.zon), host language for build logic (build.zig). Because .zon is bespoke, cross-ecosystem tools like ecosyste.ms and git-pkgs must implement custom parsers.

items.title: Registry
items.text:
• Architecture: 将源主机作为注册表，与 Go modules 和 Deno 并列。没有中央索引；包直接作为 tarball 或 git ref 提供。

    • Architecture: Source host as registry, alongside Go modules and Deno. No central index; packages are served directly as tarballs or git refs.

  • Review Model: 无。无论谁控制了 URL，就控制了有效载荷。

    • Review Model: None. Whosoever controls the URL controls the payload.

  • Namespacing: 基于 URL 的定位，并与自生成的 64 位指纹配对作为身份。

    • Namespacing: URL-based location, paired with a self-generated 64-bit fingerprint for identity.

  • Distribution Model: 仅源代码，在客户端上编译。

    • Distribution Model: Source-only, compiled on the client.

  • Ecosystem Scope: 语言特定，尽管 C/C++ 库经常通过 zig cc 打包为 Zig 依赖项。

    • Ecosystem Scope: Language-specific, though C/C++ libraries are frequently packaged as Zig dependencies via zig cc.

  • Version Retention: 完全委托给源主机（例如，GitHub releases）。没有原生的包撤回机制。

    • Version Retention: Delegated entirely to the source host (e.g., GitHub releases). There is no native package yank mechanism.

items.title: Governance
items.text:
Zig 软件基金会负责管理语言和工具链，但包托管和命名空间完全超出了其职权范围。

The Zig Software Foundation governs the language and toolchain, but package hosting and namespacing fall completely outside its remit.

命名所有权是去中心化的，仅通过围绕 fingerprint 字段的社会约定来执行。滥用处理、可用性、账户恢复和 DMCA 删除完全推迟给源主机（绝大多数是 GitHub）。正如 ZSF 的 Loris Cro 在 2022 年所说：“我们不打算创建官方的包索引。”

Name ownership is decentralised and enforced only by social convention around the fingerprint field. Abuse handling, availability, account recovery, and DMCA takedowns are deferred entirely to the source host (overwhelmingly GitHub). As Loris Cro of the ZSF stated in 2022, "we don’t plan to create an official package index."

items.title: Comparisons
items.text:
• Go Modules & Deno (Pre-JSR): 架构上最接近的亲属——URL 寻址的源、没有发布步骤、没有中央注册表，以及通过内容哈希验证的完整性。

    • Go Modules & Deno (Pre-JSR): Closest architectural relatives—URL-addressed source, no publish step, no central registry, and integrity verified via content hash.

  • Bazel (http_archive): 使用 URL 列表加上 SHA-256 哈希，其中哈希是标识，URL 是可互换的镜像，评估一个密封的 Starlark 构建文件。

    • Bazel (http_archive): Uses a URL list plus a SHA-256 hash where the hash is the identity and URLs are interchangeable mirrors, evaluating a hermetic Starlark build file.

  • Missing Features: 与 Cargo ([patch]) 或 Go (replace) 不同，Zig 缺乏原生的清单级依赖覆盖机制。虽然存在 --fork CLI 标志，但它在提交的存储库中没有留下记录，这使得在修补传递依赖项时的可重现构建变得复杂。

    • Missing Features: Unlike Cargo ([patch]) or Go (replace), Zig lacks a native manifest-level dependency override mechanism. While a --fork CLI flag exists, it leaves no record in the committed repository, complicating reproducible builds when patching transitive dependencies.

items.title: Client
items.text:
• Code Execution at Install Time: zig build --fetch 不执行不受信任的代码——它下载 URL，验证哈希，并将 .zon 文件作为纯数据解析。但是，zig build 在构建阶段以用户权限编译和运行依赖构建脚本 (build.zig)。

    • Code Execution at Install Time: zig build --fetch executes no untrusted code—it downloads URLs, verifies hashes, and parses .zon files as pure data. However, zig build compiles and runs dependency build scripts (build.zig) with user privileges during the build phase.

  • Lockfile Guarantees: 清单固定了 SHA-256 哈希，确保了获取后的确定性构建。但是，没有公共的透明度日志（不像 Go 的校验和数据库）来验证首次记录哈希时 URL 提供了什么内容。

    • Lockfile Guarantees: Manifests pin SHA-256 hashes, ensuring deterministic builds post-fetch. However, there is no public transparency log (unlike Go's checksum database) to verify what a URL served the moment a hash was first recorded.

  • Dependency Confusion: 通过设计得到了缓解，因为每个依赖项条目直接映射到一个单一的显式 URL。

    • Dependency Confusion: Mitigated by design, as each dependency entry maps directly to a single explicit URL.

items.title: Registry
items.text:
• Maintainer Lifecycle: 通过上游源主机权限（如 GitHub 协作者）进行处理。受损的源库或过期的自定义域名可能导致供应链接管，这只能通过下游清单中现有的哈希固定来缓解。

    • Maintainer Lifecycle: Handled via upstream source host permissions (e.g., GitHub collaborators). Compromised source repositories or lapsed custom domains can result in supply chain takeovers, mitigated only by existing hash pins in downstream manifests.

  • Immutability: Git 标签可以被强制推送，或者 GitHub release 资源被替换；客户端接收到他们固定的字节，但如果上游标签发生变化，新的消费者就有拉取到被修改的有效载荷的风险。

    • Immutability: Git tags can be force-pushed or GitHub release assets replaced; clients receive the bytes they pinned, but new consumers risk pulling modified payloads if upstream tags change.

items.title: The Tool’s Own Supply Chain
items.text:
Zig 编译器的自身清单声明了零外部依赖。网络操作、TLS 堆栈和解压缩器均作为 Zig 源代码发布并在 ReleaseSafe 模式下编译，从而允许开发人员检查和修补网络逻辑而无需重新编译核心编译器二进制文件。

The Zig compiler's own manifest declares zero external dependencies. Network operations, TLS stacks, and decompressors ship as Zig source code compiled in ReleaseSafe mode, allowing developers to inspect and patch networking logic without rebuilding the core compiler binary.

items.title: Conclusion
items.text:
Zig 的方法——将内容哈希视为真正的包身份，而将 URL 仅视为镜像——在概念上是合理的，并且将 .zon 保持为纯数据允许安全地解析依赖图。此外，编译器的零依赖足迹树立了一个模范的供应链标准。

Zig’s approach—treating the content hash as the true package identity while treating URLs as mere mirrors—is conceptually sound, and keeping .zon as pure data allows safe parsing of dependency graphs. Furthermore, the compiler's zero-dependency footprint sets an exemplary supply chain standard.

然而，定制的 .zon 格式给跨生态系统的工具带来了额外的解析开销，而图灵完备的构建脚本阻碍了生态系统通过“星期二测试”。通过将治理完全交给 GitHub，生态系统承担了依赖账户恢复和滥用处理的外部风险，同时目前缺乏传递依赖覆盖也让开发人员在进行紧急安全修补时变得十分繁琐。

However, the bespoke .zon format imposes parsing overhead on cross-ecosystem tooling, and Turing-complete build scripts prevent the ecosystem from passing the "Tuesday test." By offloading governance entirely to GitHub, the ecosystem inherits external dependencies on account recovery and abuse handling, while the current lack of transitive dependency overrides makes emergency security patching cumbersome for developers.

items.title: 引入 GPT‑Live：ChatGPT 语音功能的新时代 (Introducing GPT‑Live: A New Era for ChatGPT Voice)
path: 引入 GPT‑Live：ChatGPT 语音功能的新时代 (Introducing GPT‑Live: A New Era for ChatGPT Voice)

items.title: 文章背景与核心概要
items.text: OpenAI 正式为其 ChatGPT 语音模式升级了驱动模型，推出了全新的“GPT-Live”系统。该系统通过在后台将复杂推理和网页搜索任务委派给强大的 GPT-5.5 模型，在保持对话流畅不中断的同时，提供了更流畅、更智能的体验。此举彻底摆脱了以往依赖旧模型的局限，使语音模式成为日常陪伴和头脑风暴的理想选择。
path: 引入 GPT‑Live：ChatGPT 语音功能的新时代 (Introducing GPT‑Live: A New Era for ChatGPT Voice)

items.title: 语音交互的演进
items.text:
[有一段时间，ChatGPT 的语音模式让人感觉停滞不前，它依赖于一个知识库截止到 2024 年的老旧 GPT-4o 时代模型。这种局限性使其作为头脑风暴伙伴的效用大打折扣。GPT-Live 的推出标志着一次重大飞跃，提供了一个功能更强大、响应更迅速的交互界面。]

For some time, the ChatGPT voice mode felt stagnant, relying on an aging GPT-4o era model with a 2024 knowledge cutoff. This limitation made it less effective as a brainstorming partner. The introduction of GPT-Live marks a significant leap forward, providing a more capable and responsive interface.
path: 引入 GPT‑Live：ChatGPT 语音功能的新时代 (Introducing GPT‑Live: A New Era for ChatGPT Voice)

items.title: 智能任务委派
items.text:
[GPT-Live 最令人印象深刻的功能之一，是它能够在不打破对话节奏的情况下处理复杂的查询。正如 OpenAI 所解释的那样：]

One of the most impressive features of GPT-Live is its ability to handle complex queries without breaking the flow of conversation. As OpenAI explains:

[“对于需要网页搜索、更深层次推理或更复杂工作的提问，它会在幕后将其委派给我们最新的前沿模型，并在结果准备就绪时将其带回对话中。在处理的同时，GPT‑Live 可以继续与您交谈并保持对话的流畅性。在推出时，GPT‑Live 将在后台使用 GPT‑5.5。随着我们发布新的前沿模型，我们将不断更新 GPT‑Live 所使用的模型。”]

"For questions that require web search, deeper reasoning, or more complex work, it delegates to our latest frontier model behind the scenes and brings the result back into the conversation when it’s ready. While it works, GPT‑Live can keep talking with you and maintain the flow of conversation. At launch, GPT‑Live will use GPT‑5.5 in the background. As we release new frontier models, we’ll continuously update the model used by GPT‑Live."
path: 引入 GPT‑Live：ChatGPT 语音功能的新时代 (Introducing GPT‑Live: A New Era for ChatGPT Voice)

items.title: 优化体验
items.text:
[早期预览用户指出测试阶段存在一些小问题，包括该模型偶尔会在不合时宜的时候插话大笑。根据用户反馈，据报道 OpenAI 已经改进了该模型的行为，使其不再那么突兀。]

Early preview users noted some quirks during the testing phase, including an issue where the model would occasionally interrupt with laughter at inappropriate times. After user feedback, OpenAI has reportedly refined the model's behavior to be less intrusive.

[一位用户指出，一个关于猫头鹰行为看似无害的问题——“那么猫头鹰在黄昏之前不在的时候都在哪儿？猫头鹰是存在的吧？它们是藏在洞里吗？它们藏在哪里？”——此前曾引发人工智能一阵尴尬而居高临下的笑声。幸运的是，此类行为漏洞似乎已成为过去式。]

One user noted that a seemingly innocuous question about owl behavior—"so where are the owls when they're not, like before dusk? The owls exist, right? Are they hiding in holes? Where are they hiding?"—had previously triggered an awkward, condescending laugh from the AI. Fortunately, such behavioral bugs appear to be a thing of the past.
path: 引入 GPT‑Live：ChatGPT 语音功能的新时代 (Introducing GPT‑Live: A New Era for ChatGPT Voice)

items.title: 最终想法
items.text:
[凭借维持长达一小时的有意义对话的能力，GPT-Live 正把自己定位为日常活动的更可行伴侣，从遛狗到深入的头脑风暴会议皆能胜任。]

With the ability to sustain hour-long, meaningful conversations, GPT-Live is positioning itself as a much more viable companion for daily activities, from walking the dog to deep-dive brainstorming sessions.

items.title: 我与理性主义者社区的决裂
path: 我与理性主义者社区的决裂

items.title: 背景与摘要
items.text: 在本文中，作者深刻反思了自己对旧金山湾区理性主义运动逐渐幻灭的过程。文章追溯了从 20 世纪 90 年代初期的 Usenet 争论，到现代“理性主义者”（以 LessWrong 和有效利他主义为代表）的演变。作者指出，曾经追求智力严谨的社区逐渐沦为使用“动机推理”、傲慢且纵容有毒网络行为的地方。最终，作者解释了为何选择离开这个试图用逻辑和理性为自私结论辩护的群体。
path: 我与理性主义者社区的决裂

items.title: Summary
items.text:
在这篇反思性文章中，作者探讨了他们长期以来对公开批评旧金山湾区理性主义运动的犹豫不决。通过追溯互联网怀疑论者文化从 20 世纪 90 年代古怪的 Usenet 争论演变到现代理性主义（通过 LessWrong 和有效利他主义）的兴起，作者阐明了智力上的严谨性是如何频繁退化为动机推理、傲慢以及有毒的网络行为的。最终，这篇文章解释了为什么作者选择离开一个将逻辑武器化以证明其自私结论合理的社区。

In this reflective essay, the author explores their long-standing hesitation to publicly critique the SF Bay Area rationalist movement. Tracing the evolution of internet skeptic culture from the quirky Usenet debates of the 1990s to the rise of modern rationalism (via LessWrong and Effective Altruism), the author illustrates how intellectual rigor frequently devolved into motivated reasoning, arrogance, and toxic online behavior. Ultimately, the piece explains why the author chose to walk away from a community that weaponized logic to justify self-serving conclusions.
path: 我与理性主义者社区的决裂

items.title: Introduction
items.text:
这是一篇我抵制了很久才决定写的文章。在 2010 年代中期，即旧金山湾区理性主义运动的鼎盛时期，我没有痛下决心。在与理性主义结盟的金融家 Sam Bankman-Fried 被捕后，我抵制了这种冲动。而在 2025 年初爆发了涉及起源于同一社区的一个据称是性与谋杀邪教组织 (Zizians) 的丑闻之后，我更是强忍住一言不发。

This is an article I resisted writing for a long time. I didn’t pull the trigger in the mid-2010s, in the glory days of the SF Bay Area rationalist movement. I resisted the urge after the arrest of the rationalist-aligned financier, Sam Bankman-Fried. And I bit my tongue real hard in the wake of the early 2025 scandal involving the Zizians, an alleged sex-and-murder cult that originated from the same community.

我犹豫了这么久，部分原因在于理性主义运动有着非常出色的营销：如果你出言反对这种意识形态，听起来就像是你站在了非理性的一边。而且，仅仅因为偶尔出现的谋杀邪教就去谴责整个社区，这真的公平吗？你们中间谁是没有罪的，谁就可以先拿石头打他……

Part of the reason why I hesitated for so long is that the rationalist movement has brilliant marketing: if you speak against the ideology, it sounds like you’re siding with irrationality. And is it really fair to condemn the entire community just because of the occasional murder cult? He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone…

不过，糟糕的笑话到此为止。今天，我想提供一个更个人的视角，谈谈我是如何卷入这场运动的早期形态的，以及为什么我早在所有那些所谓的谋杀事件发生之前，就已经对它充满警惕了。

But enough with bad jokes. Today, I wanted to offer a more personal perspective on how I got involved with the early form of the movement and why I’ve grown wary of it long before all the alleged murdering.
path: 我与理性主义者社区的决裂

items.title: The Skeptic in You
items.text:
如果你当时不在场，很难解释 20 世纪 90 年代的互联网有多么古怪。那是相距甚远的文化首次发生碰撞的时候。没有人卖东西，没有人买东西，也没有人赚大钱。那简直就是纯粹的雅科夫·斯米尔诺夫式的喜剧。

If you weren’t there, it’s hard to explain just how quirky the internet of the 1990s was. It’s when distant cultures made contact for the first time. No one was selling, no one was buying, no one was making big bucks. It was just pure Yakov Smirnoff comedy.

那时，建立网络的科学家和工程师们发现自己和“怪人”被关在同一个房间里——那些相信外星人绑架、大脚怪、永动机等事物的人。你可以想象，这些新来者抓住了机会，以最直接的方式挑战学术共识。

It’s when the scientists and engineers who built the network found themselves locked in the same room with “kooks” — those who believed in alien abductions, Bigfoot, perpetual motion, and so on. As you can imagine, these newcomers seized the opportunity to challenge the academic consensus in the most direct way possible.

随后在 Usenet 和网络论坛上爆发的争斗吸引了大量旁观者，并成为互联网最早的文化现象之一。当然，作为一个理性的人，你希望站在科学家这一边；至少，这似乎是明智之举。科学阵营——怀疑论者——有两位守护神：詹姆斯·兰迪 (James Randi)，一位转行调查超自然现象欺诈的魔术师；以及理查德·道金斯 (Richard Dawkins)，一位最初以反对教会而闻名的进化生物学家。

The resulting fights on Usenet and web forums attracted crowds of spectators and turned into one of the internet’s earliest cultural phenomena. Of course, as a rational person, you wanted to side with the scientists; if nothing else, it seemed like the winning move. The scientific camp — the skeptics — had two patron saints: James Randi, a magician turned investigator of paranormal fraud; and Richard Dawkins, an evolutionary biologist originally known for speaking against the church.

随着怀疑论者社区的巩固，它开始转为进攻：我们以猎杀怪人为乐，并磨练我们的修辞技巧。我们对所有的逻辑谬误都倒背如流，并随时准备好了引用来源。这种感觉令人陶醉：你是房间里最聪明的人，能够只需一次外科手术般的反驳就能立刻羞辱任何地平论者。

As the skeptic community solidified, it started to play offense: we hunted cranks for sport and honed our rhetorical skills. We knew all the logical fallacies by heart and had citations at the ready. It felt intoxicating: you were the smart guy in the room, able to immediately humiliate any flat-earther with a single, surgical rebuke.

即便是那时，这种消遣有时也会变得很粗俗。我记得“时间立方” (Timecube) 事件；Timecube 是一个杂乱无章的意识流网站，充斥着离奇的宇宙学主张。它显然是由一个患有精神疾病的人建立的，但这并没有阻止社区在那里找乐子。这场闹剧在网站的所有者——一位老年人——被学生邀请去麻省理工学院和佐治亚理工学院录制“讲座”时达到了顶峰，目的仅仅是为了低级趣味。

Even back then, the pastime sometimes turned crass. I remember the Timecube affair; Timecube was an incoherent stream-of-consciousness website filled with bizarre cosmological claims. It was clearly put together by a mentally ill person, but that didn’t stop the community from having fun. The spectacle culminated in the site’s owner — an elderly man — being invited by students to give recorded “lectures” at MIT and Georgia Tech, simply for cheap laughs.
path: 我与理性主义者社区的决裂

items.title: A More Potent Drug
items.text:
到了 2000 年代末，书呆子们的社会经济地位开始发生变化。尽管流行文化仍然把我们描绘成无害的怪人，但许多技术人员觉得他们已经赢得了在成年人桌上的一席之地——并且凭借他们庞大的智力，他们对世界的看法是有分量的。

By the late 2000s, the socioeconomic status of nerds began to change. Although pop culture still portrayed us as harmless dorks, many techies felt that they earned a seat at the grownup table — and that by virtue of their vast intellect, their opinions about the world carried weight.

大约在那个时候，在尤其富裕的旧金山湾区，怀疑论者社区将自己重新包装为理性主义者，并围绕着诸如 Slate Star Codex 和 LessWrong 等网站聚集在一起。这个新社区较少关心仅仅对科学谬误做出反应；相反，他们主动寻找对于他们认为是我们这个时代最重要问题的“正确”答案。

Around that time, the skeptic community in the especially affluent SF Bay Area rebranded themselves as rationalists, coalescing around websites such as Slate Star Codex and LessWrong. This new community was less concerned with merely reacting to scientific falsehoods; instead, they proactively sought the “correct” answers to what they felt were the most consequential questions of our time.

当然，尽管强调理性——并含蓄地暗示群体外的人犯了更多错误——理性主义者社区也容易受到像其他人一样的偏见影响。首先，他们的分析几乎总是等于对他们喜欢的事物进行事后辩护。一个著名的例子是有效利他主义运动：它始于这样一个前提，即在慈善捐赠中，你应该最大化每一美元支出所产生的善意。由此，你可以争辩说，如果能最大化你的盈利潜力，那么为一家不道德的公司工作是没问题的——因为这样你就能通过你的捐款拯救更多生命。最后，今天造成的伤害可以被对尚未出生的后代所带来的好处抵消——这不知何故意味着为一家加密货币或 AI 初创公司工作是你所能做出的最合乎道德的选择。或者，正如另一位人士所言：有效利他主义者得出结论，他们能做的最慈善的事情就是给自己买一座城堡（字面意义上的）。

Of course, despite the emphasis on reason — and the subtle implication that the out-group is more wrong — the rationalist community is susceptible to the same biases as anyone else. For one, their analyses almost always amounted to post hoc justifications of the things they liked. A well-known example is the effective altruism movement: it started with the premise that in charitable giving, you should maximize the amount of good per dollar spent. From this, you could argue it’s okay to work for an unethical company if it maximizes your earning potential — and thus, saves more lives through the donations you make. And finally, the harms caused today could be offset by the benefits to generations yet unborn — which somehow meant that working for a cryptocurrency or AI startup was the most ethical choice you could make. Or, as someone else put it: effective altruists concluded that the most charitable thing they could do is to buy themselves a castle (literally).

偏见的另一个来源是，理性主义者在选择想要进行的辩论时必然是具有选择性的。在日常生活中，他们和普通人一样依赖直觉和轶事；但如果他们想争辩你的人生选择，他们会强行这么做，而且是打着寻求科学真理的幌子。这种行为非常普遍，甚至有了一个专有名词：海狮攻击 (sealioning)。

Another source of bias is that rationalists are necessarily selective in the arguments they want to have. In everyday life, they rely on intuition and anecdotes the same as anyone else; but if they want to debate your life choices, they will do so forcibly and under the guise of seeking scientific truth. The behavior is pervasive enough to have its own name: sealioning.

关于这一点，我记得 2017 年的詹姆斯·达莫尔 (James Damore) 事件——一位谷歌员工撰写了一份内部备忘录，认为性别之间存在根本差异，这使得女性对技术工作的兴趣较低。备忘录本身以及达莫尔先生随后的被解雇事件，在全国媒体上引起了轩然大波。鲜为人知的是，这份备忘录最初是被发送到 skeptics@google.com 邮件列表的，我也是该列表的一员。这是一种伪装成理性主义探究的个人信仰——还带着引用文献！——试图把所有人都卷入一场没人想要的职场争论。

On that note, I remember the 2017 affair of James Damore — a Googler who penned an internal memo arguing that there are fundamental differences between sexes that make women less interested in tech jobs. The memo itself, and Mr. Damore’s subsequent firing, made waves in the national media. What’s less known is that the memo was originally sent to the skeptics@google.com mailing list, which I was a member of. It was a personal belief masquerading as a rationalist inquiry — with citations! — that tried to pull everyone into an unwanted workplace argument.

到那个时候，我与怀疑论者社区的关系已经很紧张了；在早先发给同一个邮件列表的一条消息中，我说过，尽管大家声称是开明的，但这里却是唯一一个仍然流行用石头砸死人的地方。即便如此，当我看到达莫尔的电子邮件时，我有一阵短暂的回复冲动。我想指责他“动机推理”——即为了推进某个特定结论而构建论证的所谓谬误，这与真正的理性主义者那种神圣的、无动机的推理形成了对比。

By that time, my relationship with the skeptic community was already strained; in an earlier message to the same mailing list, I said that for all the claims of being enlightened, it’s the only place where stonings are still in fashion. Even so, when I saw the Damore email, I had a brief urge to respond. I wanted to accuse him of “motivated reasoning” — a purported fallacy of constructing an argument to advance a specific conclusion, in contrast to the divine, unmotivated reasoning of real rationalists.

我咬紧牙关，心里想，“哇，这游戏真蠢，”然后删除了草稿。

I bit my tongue, thought to myself, "Wow, what a stupid game to play," and deleted the draft.
